title: Duration of Certain Leases and Notice to Terminate
summary: In the absence of a written contract or local law to the contrary, a lease of immovable property for any purpose other than agriculture or manufacturing shall be deemed to be a lease from month to month, terminable on fifteen days notice expiring with the end of a month of the tenancy.
verbatim_extract: a lease of immovable property for any other purpose shall be deemed to be a lease from month to month, terminable, on the part of either lessor or lessee, by fifteen days' notice...

title: Rights and Liabilities of Lessor - Quiet Possession
summary: The landlord is bound to give possession of the property and ensures that the tenant who pays the rent reserved and performs contractual terms may hold the property during the lease without interruption.
verbatim_extract: the lessor is bound on the lessee's request to put him in possession of the property... the lessor shall be deemed to contract with the lessee that... he may hold the property during the time specified without interruption...

title: Liability of Lessee - Restoration and Wear and Tear
summary: The tenant is bound to keep and restore the property in as good condition as it was when put into possession, subject only to the changes caused by reasonable wear and tear or irresistible force.
verbatim_extract: the lessee is bound to keep, and on the termination of the lease to restore, the property in as good condition as it was in at the time when he was put in possession, subject only to the changes caused by reasonable wear and tear...

title: Security Deposit Rules and Refund Mandate
summary: The security deposit for residential premises shall not exceed two months' rent. The deposit must be refunded to the tenant on the date of taking over vacant possession of the premises, after making legitimate deductions for unpaid rent or damage exceeding normal wear and tear.
verbatim_extract: The security deposit to be paid by the tenant in advance shall not exceed two months rent, in case of residential premises... The security deposit shall be refunded to the tenant on the date of taking over vacant possession...

title: Mandatory Written Tenancy Agreement
summary: No person shall let or take on rent any premises except by an agreement in writing, which shall be informed to the Rent Authority jointly by landlord and tenant.
verbatim_extract: no person shall, after the commencement of this Act, let or take on rent any premises except by an agreement in writing, which shall be informed to the Rent Authority...

title: Protection Against Wrongful Eviction
summary: A landlord cannot evict a tenant during the agreed tenancy period except by applying to the Rent Court under specified grounds (such as failure to pay agreed rent for two consecutive months, subletting without consent, or misuse). Forced self-help eviction or cutting utilities is unlawful.
verbatim_extract: No tenant shall be evicted from any premises, except on an application made by the landlord to the Rent Court on one or more of the following grounds...

title: State-Specific Tenancy Legislation Dependency
summary: Tenancy and rent regulation in India are state subjects. Specific procedures, eviction grounds, and rent courts depend on the respective state act (e.g. Maharashtra Rent Control Act 1999, Delhi Rent Control Act 1958, Karnataka Rent Act 1999, Tamil Nadu Regulation of Rights and Responsibilities of Landlords and Tenants Act 2017).
verbatim_extract: Landlord-tenant relationships are governed by the relevant State Rent Control and Tenancy laws enacted under List II (State List) of the Seventh Schedule of the Constitution of India.
